entries.partTitle: Architectural Blueprint & Multi-Tier Material/Atmosphere Pipeline Specifications

spec.title: System Architecture: Architectural Blueprint & Multi-Tier Material/Atmosphere Pipeline Specifications

steps.caption: Architectural overview displays the unified multi-tier rendering blueprint orchestrating surface and atmospheric passes.
Deep inspection tracks full-resolution G-Buffers, screen-space diffusion, and quarter-resolution sky queues.
Comparative analysis demonstrates optimal GPU scheduling preventing stalls between surface and volumetric passes.
Verification confirms total pass budget execution under eight point five milliseconds with generous headroom.

entries.partTitle: Screen-Space Subsurface Scattering: Separable Normalized Burley Diffusion Integration

spec.title: System Architecture: Screen-Space Subsurface Scattering: Separable Normalized Burley Diffusion Integration

steps.caption: Architectural overview illustrates screen-space subsurface integration applying separable Burley diffusion kernels.
Deep inspection evaluates five-tap horizontal and vertical filtering with depth rejection thresholds.
Comparative analysis demonstrates smooth skin translucency while preserving razor-sharp geometric silhouettes.
Verification confirms normalized kernel tap decay, zero edge bleeding, and warm shadow penumbras.

entries.partTitle: Thin-Film Iridescence & Anisotropic Hair/Fiber Microfacet Shading

spec.title: System Architecture: Thin-Film Iridescence & Anisotropic Hair/Fiber Microfacet Shading

steps.caption: Architectural overview displays composite material shading combining thin-film iridescence with anisotropic hair models.
Deep inspection tracks optical path difference phase modulation and cylindrical fiber specular highlights.
Comparative analysis demonstrates rich tactile realism across complex character garments and hairstyles.
Verification confirms energy-conserving composite specular radiance and smooth multi-lobe transitions.

entries.partTitle: Volumetric Cloudscape & Planetary Atmosphere with Early Ray Termination

spec.title: System Architecture: Volumetric Cloudscape & Planetary Atmosphere with Early Ray Termination

steps.caption: Architectural overview illustrates real-time volumetric atmospheric ray marching with early termination and powder shading.
Deep inspection tracks step-by-step optical depth accumulation, dual-lobe scattering, and opacity thresholds.
Comparative analysis demonstrates dramatic compute savings from early ray termination inside dense cloud cores.
Verification confirms radiant silver linings, deep crevice shadows, and efficient volumetric traversal.

entries.partTitle: Engine Production Integration, 5-Gate Defense Matrix & Telemetry Benchmarking

spec.title: System Architecture: Engine Production Integration, 5-Gate Defense Matrix & Telemetry Benchmarking

steps.caption: Architectural overview displays the automated five-gate quality defense matrix and telemetry monitoring daemon.
Deep inspection audits SSS energy conservation, phase accuracy, specular bounds, reconstruction, and frame times.
Comparative analysis confirms full certification across all five defense gates at seventy-two frames per second.
Verification locks Milestone Ten completion, certifying cinema-quality real-time graphics production readiness.
